model: Existing production HistGradientBoostingRegressor, 24 horizons, squared_error, max_iter=40, max_leaf_nodes=15, l2_regularization=1, seed=42
features: Schema 2: existing prices/calendar plus versioned public holidays and genuinely origin-known target demand; missing demand is explicitly missing
selection: No new model or hyperparameter search; baseline ranking uses July validation common pairs only
sensitivityRecommendation: Retain k=3 pending team agreement; descriptive k=2/3/4 comparison is not threshold selection
truth: Official EMC historical final prices; reconstructed period-end availability only under explicit RETROSPECTIVE_FINAL_PRICE assumption
prohibitions: No demand receipt timestamps invented from historical CSV demand columns
priorExposure: Collector research examined September 24 onward, so test ends before that history. Individual August 30/September 4 observations and the September 20 official sample were previously inspected; model-unseen evaluation is not a claim of complete analyst blindness.
